grades.main_gap: Periodicity of S — the core of the problem — is entirely unproved; the write-up itself states the needed lemma is 'still under development'.
grades.notes: The S-enumeration lemma is correctly proven: each term lies in S, and any x between consecutive terms fails some gcd condition by minimality. This is a genuine but small reduction. All hard work (finiteness of relevant primes, S a finite union of residue classes, alignment at a_1) is absent; computations and conjectures earn no credit.
